home.meta_title: Slowtime - Book your car wash online

features.title: Your car deserves
features.item_1_desc: Book your bay in advance. Arrive at the exact time. Never again face a bad surprise or endless waiting for a spot.

testimonials.title: What our
testimonials.t1_quote: I book in 30 seconds from my phone. I arrive, my bay is ready, I leave. That is exactly what I was looking for.
testimonials.t2_quote: The 45-minute reminders are perfect. I have never missed my slot again. And the automatic refund when I had to cancel was instant.
testimonials.t3_quote: I found my regular station through Slowtime. Reviews are genuine, listed prices are the real prices. No surprise on arrival.

faq.title: Everything you
faq.a1: Yes, registration and use of Slowtime are entirely free for customers. You only pay for the wash service at the price listed by the station.
faq.q2: How does the refund work when cancelling?
faq.a2: If you cancel within the allowed period, an automatic refund is initiated via Stripe. A penalty may apply for late cancellations per the station policy.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Payment is handled by Stripe, one of the most secure platforms in the world. Your card data never passes through Slowtime servers.
faq.q4: What happens if I am late?
faq.a4: Report your delay from the 45-min notification. The station can accept it or move you into the queue. If you report nothing, no-show fees may apply.
faq.a5: Slowtime is currently live in Montreal and its region. Expansion to other Quebec cities is planned.
faq.q6: How do I request account deletion?
faq.a6: In accordance with Law 25, you can export or delete your data at any time from Settings in the app.

faq_page.meta_desc: Find answers to your questions about Slowtime: bookings, cancellations, payments and more.
faq_page.title: Frequently Asked
faq_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Slowtime. If you can't find your answer here, reach out to us.
faq_page.q1: How do I book a car wash?
faq_page.a1: Create an account, choose a nearby station, select a time slot and a package, then confirm your booking. You'll receive a confirmation email.
faq_page.a2: Yes, you can cancel up to 2 hours before your appointment from your client area. After that deadline, cancellation fees may apply according to the station's policy.
faq_page.a3: If all slots at a station are full, you can join the waitlist. If someone cancels, you'll be automatically notified and your spot confirmed.
faq_page.a4: We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express through our secure Stripe platform. Payment is processed at the time of booking.
faq_page.q5: How do I become a partner station?
faq_page.a5: Visit the 'Become a Partner' page and fill in the registration form. Our team reviews your application within 48 business hours.
faq_page.q6: My vehicle was damaged during the wash, what should I do?
faq_page.a6: Contact the station manager immediately on site, then report the incident from your client area within 24 hours. We'll help you resolve the dispute.
faq_page.a7: Yes, from your client area, open the booking and choose 'Modify'. Changes are allowed up to 2 hours before the scheduled time.
faq_page.a8: Each station sets its own prices based on vehicle size and wash type. Displayed prices include all applicable taxes.
faq_page.a9: Yes, we comply with Law 25 and GDPR. Your data is never sold to third parties and is encrypted during transmission.
faq_page.q10: How do I contact Slowtime support?
faq_page.a10: You can reach us via live chat on the Support page, by email at support@slowtime.ca, or browse this FAQ for an immediate answer.
faq_page.cta_desc: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM (ET).

cancel_policy.meta_desc: Review our cancellation and refund policy for car wash bookings.
cancel_policy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancel_policy.s1_p1: Slowtime is committed to a transparent experience. Cancellations are handled fairly based on the notice given before the appointment.
cancel_policy.s2_intro: The refunded amount depends on the time between cancellation and the appointment:
cancel_policy.s3_p1: To cancel, go to your client area, select the booking and click 'Cancel'. You'll receive a confirmation email.
cancel_policy.s3_p2: Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days depending on your financial institution.
cancel_policy.s4_p1: If a station cancels your appointment, you receive a full 100% refund and a compensation credit may be offered depending on the circumstances.
cancel_policy.s5_p1: In case of an unreported absence (no-show), the full booking amount is retained. Additional fees may apply if the station reserved time for your visit.

cgu_page.meta_desc: Read the terms and conditions governing the use of the Slowtime platform.
cgu_page.title: Terms of Use
cgu_page.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the Slowtime platform. By using our services, you unconditionally accept these terms.
cgu_page.a1_body: Slowtime is a platform connecting clients wishing to book a car wash with partner washing stations. The operating company acts as a technical intermediary.
cgu_page.a2_body: Access to Slowtime services requires creating a user account. You must be at least 18 years old and own a registered vehicle to use the service as a client.
cgu_page.a3_body: You agree to provide accurate information upon registration, not to use the platform for fraudulent purposes, and to comply with the rules of partner stations during your visit.
cgu_page.a4_body: Bookings are confirmed only after full payment. Prices are displayed inclusive of taxes. Slowtime collects a commission on each transaction in accordance with the applicable fee schedule.
cgu_page.a5_body: Cancellation and refund conditions are detailed in our Cancellation Policy, accessible from the footer. In case of dispute, Slowtime acts as mediator.
cgu_page.a6_body: All content on the platform (logos, texts, interfaces, source code) is the exclusive property of Slowtime or its partners and is protected by intellectual property laws.
cgu_page.a7_body: Slowtime processes your data in accordance with its Privacy Policy and Law 25 (Quebec). You have the right to access, correct and delete your data.
cgu_page.a8_body: Slowtime cannot be held liable for damage caused during washing by a partner station. Each station remains responsible for its services and staff.
cgu_page.a9_body: Slowtime reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Users will be notified by email at least 15 days before the new terms take effect.
cgu_page.a10_body: These Terms are governed by Quebec and Canadian law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

privacy_page.meta_desc: Learn how Slowtime collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Slowtime collects, uses and protects your personal data in accordance with Law 25 (Quebec) and applicable Canadian laws.
privacy_page.a1_body: We collect information you provide during registration (name, email address, phone number), as well as browsing data generated by your use of the platform (pages visited, actions taken, device technical data).
privacy_page.a2_body: Your data is used to create and manage your account, process your bookings and payments, send you activity notifications, improve our services and ensure platform security.
privacy_page.a3_body: Your personal data is never sold to third parties. It may be shared with partner stations in the context of a confirmed booking, and with our technical service providers (hosting, payments) bound by strict confidentiality obligations.
privacy_page.a4_body: Slowtime uses cookies essential to platform operation (authentication, security) and anonymous analytics cookies to measure audience. You may refuse non-essential cookies through your browser settings.
privacy_page.a5_body: Your data is retained for as long as necessary to fulfil the contract and meet our legal obligations, up to a maximum of 5 years after account closure, unless otherwise required by law.
privacy_page.a6_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures (TLS encryption, restricted access, regular audits) to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or disclosure.
privacy_page.a7_body: Under Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25), you have the right to access, correct, port and delete your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@slowtime.ca.
privacy_page.a8_body: Some of our service providers may process data outside Quebec. We conduct a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) prior to any transfer and ensure an equivalent level of protection.
privacy_page.a9_body: Slowtime's privacy officer can be reached at privacy@slowtime.ca. Any request relating to your data will be handled within 30 days.
privacy_page.a10_body: Slowtime reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. You will be notified by email at least 15 days before any material change takes effect.

cgu_stations_page.meta_desc: Terms and conditions applicable to partner stations on the Slowtime platform.
cgu_stations_page.title: Partner Station Terms
cgu_stations_page.intro: These Terms of Use govern the relationship between Slowtime and partner car wash stations registered on the platform. By activating your station account, you unconditionally accept these terms.
cgu_stations_page.a1_body: Slowtime provides partner stations with a booking management tool, an integrated payment system and visibility on the client platform. The operating company acts as a technical intermediary.
cgu_stations_page.a2_body: Access to the station space is conditional on validation of a KYC file (business permit, director's identity proof, address certificate). Any false declaration results in immediate account termination.
cgu_stations_page.a3_body: The station agrees to keep its availability slots up to date, honour confirmed bookings, respect prices displayed on the platform and treat clients professionally.
cgu_stations_page.a4_body: Slowtime collects a commission on each booking made through the platform. The rate is set in the applicable fee schedule. Net balance payouts occur weekly via Stripe Connect.
cgu_stations_page.a5_body: Any station cancellation after a booking is confirmed results in a full refund to the client. A cancellation rate above 10% over a rolling month may result in temporary account suspension.
cgu_stations_page.a6_body: Slowtime acts as mediator in disputes between a station and a client. Slowtime's decision is final for disputes under CAD $500. Beyond that, parties may seek recourse through the competent courts.
cgu_stations_page.a7_body: Slowtime reserves the right to suspend or terminate a station account for breach of these terms, repeated complaints, proven fraud or court order. The station is notified by email with 48 hours notice, except in emergencies.
cgu_stations_page.a8_body: The station authorizes Slowtime to use its name, logo and photos for promotional purposes on the platform and in its marketing communications, in accordance with the station's brand guidelines.
cgu_stations_page.a9_body: The station agrees not to disclose client personal information accessed through the platform to unauthorized third parties, and to use it solely in the context of service delivery.
cgu_stations_page.a10_body: These Terms are governed by Quebec and Canadian law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

support_page.meta_desc: Get help from the Slowtime team through our support centre.
support_page.title: How can we help you?
support_page.subtitle: Choose the channel that suits you best or browse our frequently asked questions below.
support_page.channel_chat_desc: Get an immediate response from our team
support_page.q1: How do I reset my password?
support_page.a1: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email address.
support_page.q2: My booking isn't showing up, what should I do?
support_page.a2: Wait a few minutes and refresh the page. If the issue persists, contact us with your confirmation email at hand.
support_page.q3: How do I update my billing information?
support_page.a3: Go to your client area → Settings → Payment to update your banking details.
support_page.q4: I haven't received my confirmation email.
support_page.a4: Check your spam folder. If you can't find it, contact us with the email address used for the booking.
support_page.q5: Can I book on behalf of someone else?
support_page.a5: Yes, during booking you can enter the licence plate of the vehicle in question. Payment is made with your account.
support_page.q6: How do I report a problem with a station?
support_page.a6: From your client area, open the relevant booking and click 'Report a problem'. Our team handles reports within 48 hours.
